description: Provenance for uniswap_v4_pons_snapshot_robinhood.json. Every field of that snapshot is derived from on-chain data for Pons V2 pool 0xc96847cc43f7595aafcbc1c99d335cb91be7ce1107524c87030f48a716a5f289 on Robinhood chain 4663, initialized in block 58759099 by transaction 0xf66ca58190cc186683267cb486bbc6e1f0469176b7ad4f92e43eb68a1a0936e5. The pool holds a single full-range position opened in that same transaction, so the snapshot is the pool's state at the end of its creation block.

fields.field: component.static_attributes.hooks / key_lp_fee / tick_spacing, state.attributes.sqrt_price_x96 / tick, component.tokens
fields.note: PoolManager Initialize log. topic1 = pool id, topic2 = currency0 0xab5983fe30f186055095305c862b0e097dab3b52, topic3 = currency1 0xd0601ce157db5bdc3162bbac2a2c8af5320d9eec. Data words: fee 0, tickSpacing 200 (0xc8), hooks 0xe5e702641ea86f4ae6cc3cdaed2b886f976be044, sqrtPriceX96 35770440558388723996908746 (0x1d96af77dc8202588b5cca), tick -154068 (0xfda62c as int24).

fields.field: state.attributes.liquidity and the two ticks/<tick>/net-liquidity attributes
fields.note: PoolManager ModifyLiquidity log in the creation transaction: tickLower -887200, tickUpper 887200, liquidityDelta 92140088551983424709539 (0x1382ec98f6ead85fa3a3). It is the pool's only position, so the active liquidity equals it, the lower tick's net liquidity is +liquidityDelta and the upper tick's is its two's complement negative 0xec7d1367091527a05c5d.

eth_getStorageAt of launches[poolId] word 4 = 0x0000012c006413880bb80064263ed295dafae1d9aadd6e56c4b6f9f38ee019dd. creatorTaxBps sits at low-end byte offset 20 and hookFeeBps at low-end byte offset 26, both 100. Encoded the way the substreams module writes them, with BigInt::to_signed_bytes_be, which is one byte for 100.
The constant the Pons enrichment module writes, "pons_v2" as UTF-8.
The PoolManager that emitted the Initialize log holds every V4 pool's balances.

The two ERC-20 Transfer logs into the PoolManager in the creation transaction: 0xa8cff7796e7836404ff8a6 XLG and 0x024150e398003fecb9 NVDA. Nothing in the Pons decode path reads them; they are here so the fixture is a faithful component snapshot.

token_metadata_calls.description: XLG decimals and symbol, read at head. Used for the Token objects the tests build; the addresses come from the Initialize log.
